_url_note: Change to https://missionsfororphans.org/ when the site moves to its own domain.

widow_homes._note: Set both numbers (for example 9000 and 4200) to show a progress bar on widow-homes.html. Leave them null to hide it.

social._note: Fill in to show the coloured icons in the footer: whatsapp as a number with country code (e.g. "16026165557") or a wa.me link; facebook and instagram as full links (https://www.facebook.com/..., https://www.instagram.com/...). Leave null to hide an icon.
